s: Dine perot hailan, ubo k"d seipim: al kol perot hailan, ben miz' hamminim ben mishshear minim, beraka rishona shellahem hi "bore peri haetz", shemmippene chashibutam hotzium mikkelal perot haaretz, ap al pi sheggiddulam min haaretz, veqabeu lahem beraka meyuchedet, peratit umeboreret, shemmebareret uporetet chashibutam shehem peri haetz, velo gedelim baadama, kede leharbot bikbod hammaqom behazkarat shibcho bipratut, shebbara perot chashubim kipri haetz:

Lepikak, kol dabar sheggadel al haetz veeno iqqar happeri — en bo chashibut lebarek alayv "bore peri haetz", umebarekin alayv "bore peri haadama". Vehu shennoteim hailan al daat leekol gam oto dabar, kegon min ilan qatan hanniqra tzalap, shealin shello reuyin laakila, veyesh bealayv temarot boletot kemo baale araba, vegam hen reuyin laakila — mebarek al healin veal hattemarot "bore peri haadama", hoil venotein hatztzalap al daat leekol gam min healin vehattemarot, sheen memaatin et hailan bekak. Abal haqqor, shehu harosh shel deqel shennitvassep bekol shana, vehu rak verauy laakila — eno mebarek alayv "bore peri haadama" ella "shehakkol nihya bidbaro", lepi sheen notein et haddeqel al daat ken leekol et haqqor, shehaokelo memaet anpe haddeqel. Vehu haddin lelulebe gepanim:

Veken sheqedim qetannim shehem rakkim veokelam biqlippatam hachitzona — mebarekim alehem "shehakkol nihya bidbaro", sheen noteim otam ella al daat sheyyigdelu veyaasu peri betok haqqelippa. Bammeh debarim amurim? Bishqedim, sheiqqar akilatam keshehem qetannim hi qelippatam, veen noteim otam ella al daat leekol happeri shebbetokam kesheyyigdelu, abal shear kol happerot sheggam kesheokelim otam keshehem qetannim okelim miggup happeri sheyyigdal achar kak — mebarek alehem "bore peri haetz" gam keshehem qetannim, ap al pi shello nitta hailan bishbil kak, hoil veakal gup happeri shennitta hailan bishbilo. Umikkol maqom, al anabim qetannim mikkepol hallaban — eno mebarek alehem "bore peri haetz" ella "bore peri haadama", lepi sheadayin en shem peri alehem kelal, ulepikak en bahem chashibut lebarek alehem "bore peri haetz", kemo sheen chashibut bealin utemarot shel tzalap, ap al pi shennitta hailan al daat leoklam gam ken. Veshiur pol hallaban shebbimehem lo noda lanu, lepikak leolam hu mebarek "bore peri haadama" al haanabim shehem boser, ad sheyyihyu gedolim beyoter, shekkol dabar shebbirkato sapeq im hi "bore peri haadama" o "bore peri haetz" — mebarek "bore peri haadama". Umikkol maqom, en leekol mehem keshiur shechayyab beraka acharona ella betok hasseuda, kevan shehu sapeq im yebarek meen g' o "bore nepashot rabbot". Veken charubim qetannim qodem sheyyeraeh bahem kemin sharsheraot shel charubim, vezetim qodem sheyyigdal hannetz sebibam — en shem peri alehem, umebarek alehem "bore peri haadama":

Abal shear kol hailan mishsheyyotzi peri, ap al pi shehu qatan meod — shem peri alayv, umebarek alayv "bore peri haetz". Ubilbad shello yehe mar o aputz beyoter ad sheeno rauy laakila apillu al yede haddechaq, sheaz en mebarekin alayv kelal. Vaapillu im mitqo al yede haur o dabar acher — en mebarekin alayv "bore peri haetz" o "bore peri haadama" ella "shehakkol nihya bidbaro", shekkevan sheeno rauy laakila kelal belo mittuq — en shem peri alayv kelal, veeno chashub apillu kipri haadama, ella keetz beolma hu:

Veken sheqedim hammarim — en mebarekin alehem kelum keshehem gedolim, sheenam reuyim laakila apillu al yede haddechaq. Abal qetannim shehem rakkim — mebarekim alehem "bore peri haetz", ki iqqar akilatam hi haqqelippa veenah mara, veal daat ken noteim otan, abal haggedolim iqqar akilatam mah shebbipnim, vehu mar. Veim mitqan al yede haur o dabar acher — mebarekim alehem "bore peri haetz", ki hem peri gamur, venoteim otam al daat ken:

Bammeh debarim amurim shemmebarekin al perot qetannim shello nigmar bishshulam "bore peri haetz"? Beperot shennitleshu min hailan, veim lo nitleshu hayu mitbashshelim venigmarim alayv, abal hannobelot shehem pe[rot] shennisrepu mehachom venabelu venapelu min hailan qodem shennitbashshelu, veken min temarim sheen mitbashshelin al hailan ella toleshin otan veosim otam komer baaretz umitbashshelin, o notenim otam lemachtzelaot lehitchammem ad sheyyitbashshelu, veken sope anabim sheen mitbashshelin leolam mippene shehiggia hassetayv — mebarekin alehem "shehakkol nihya bidbaro", shehoil venishtannu leqilqul mechamat qor o chom o dabar acher — nigreu veyaredu mimmaalatam leinyan chashibut habberaka yoter meillu lo hayu maggiim liklal peri mippene qatnutam, shehayu mebarekin alehem "bore peri haadama" al kol panim, veakshav sheggadelu vehiggiu liklal peri venishtannu — mebarekin alehem kebirkat pat vetabshil shennishtannu leqilqul, shehi "shehakkol nihya bidbaro", kemo sheyyitbaer besiman r"d:
Veken al hachometz sheosin missope anabim — mebarekin "shehakkol" kemo al haanabim atzman, shehayyotze min haanabim — kemotan, kemo sheyyitbaer:

Garine happerot, im hem metuqim ureuyim laakila — shem peri alehen, umebarek alehen "bore peri haetz". Veim hem marim — eno mebarek alehem kelal. Veap im mitqan al yede haur o dabar acher — eno mebarek alehem ella "shehakkol nihya bidbaro", sheggarinim hammarim en shem peri alehem kelal, ukeetz beolma hem:

Haabiyyonot shel tzalap shehem iqqar happeri — mebarekin alehem "bore peri haetz". Vehaqqapresin shehi qelippa gedola shessebibot haabiyyonot, keen qelippa haggedela sebibot egozim daqqim — yesh omerim sheggam hem chashubim peri, umebarekim alehem "bore peri haetz". Veyesh omerim sheenam chashubim peri, umebarekin alehem "bore peri haadama". Veken al qelippot chitzonot shel shear perot, kegon shel rimmonim vekayyotze bahem — mebarekim "bore peri haadama", sheen mebarekin "bore peri haetz" ella al iqqar happeri, kemo shennitbaer lemala. Ulepikak mebarekin al qelippe mrntzy"n meruqqachin "bore peri haadama". Uleinyan halaka, lekattechilla yebarek "bore peri haadama", sheaz yotze ledibre hakkol, veim berak "bore peri haetz" — yatza, shessepeq berakot lehaqel. Veken bekol dabar shebbirkato sapeq:

Kol happerot shessechatan lehotzi memehem — en memehem chashubim kemotam lebarek alehem "bore peri haetz", vaapillu yatzeu meatzman, kemo debash hazzab mehattemarim, ella mebarek alehem "shehakkol nihya bidbaro", ki zea beolma hi, veenah nechshebet kegup happeri, chutz mizzetim vaanabim shehayyotze mehem kemotam, sheap shennishtannu — nishtannu leilluy, shebbeshinnuyam hem baim liklal derek akilatam, sheiqqar happeri lekak netauhu, anabim lehotzi mehen yayin, vezetim lehotzi mehen shemen, lepikak peri hu, verauy lebarek alayv "bore peri haetz". Ella shehayyayin, mippene chashibuto shessoed umesammeach halleb, kemo shekkatub "veyayin yesammach lebab enosh", hotziuhu mikkelal perot haetz veqabeu lo beraka leatzmo, vehi "bore peri haggapen", shehi beraka peratit umeboreret yoter, shemmebareret uporetet yoter chashibuto shehu peri haggepen. Veim berak "bore peri haetz" — lo yatza, apillu hu yayin chazaq sheeno rauy lishtiyya belo mayim, veen zeh derek shetiyyato vachashibuto keshehu chay. Vekol perate birkot yayin shemmebarekin alayv "bore peri haggapen" — yitbaer besiman r"d ver"b. Vehashshemen en mebarekin alayv "bore peri haetz" kesheshshotehu lebaddo kemot shehu, shehare hu mazziq legupo veeno neheneh kelal bishtiyyato, veen lebarek birkat hannehenin kelal al shetiyya zo, ella kegon sheerebo im ezeh mashqeh beinyan shenneheneh mimmennu veeno mazziqo. Veap al pi shehashshemen muat — en holekim achar harob lebarek birkat oto mashqeh, ella mebarek al taarobet zeh "bore peri haetz", shehi birkat hashshemen. Bammeh debarim amurim? Bechoshesh bigrono umitkavven lirpua bishtiyya zo, shehashshemen merakkek et haggaron umerappeo, ella mippene shei epshar lishtot shemen lebaddo lekak shoteh al yede taarobet shear mashqin harbeh mimmennu, abal kavvanato bishtiyya zo hu al hashshemen, lepikak mebarek birkat hashshemen shehi haiqqar upoter et hammashqeh hattapel, shekkol iqqar veimmo tepela — mebarek al haiqqar upoter et hattepela, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman ry"b. Abal im eno choshesh bigrono, veeno mitkavven bishtiyya zo lirpua kelal — hammashqeh iqqar, shehu harob vehashshemen tapel, veniptar bebirkat hammashqeh. Veyesh omerim sheapillu im hashshemen hu harob — eno nechshab iqqar kesheeno mitkavven lirpua, hoil veeno rauy lishtiyya belo taarobet mashqeh, ella hammashqeh iqqar umebarek alayv upoter hashshemen (velassebara harishona im hashshemen hu harob — eno mebarek kelum, mippene shemmazziq legupo, veeno neheneh bishtiyya zo kelal, mippene shehashshemen hu harob, usepeq berakot lehaqel). Veken hashshoteh chometz meorab beme shelaqot shemmebarek alehem "bore peri haadama", al derek sheyyitbaer besiman r"h, im mitkavven lirpua, kegon shechoshesh beshinnayv umegammea bahem chometz, ella mippene shehu chazaq veeno rauy lishtiyya meorbo beme shelaqot — hachometz iqqar, apillu hu muat, ume shelaqot tepelim, umebarek birkat hachometz shehi "shehakkol nihya bidbaro". Veim eno mitkavven lirpua — hachometz batel berob beme hashshelaqot. Abal im hachometz hu harob, ap shellepi sebara haacharona hamme shelaqot hem haiqqar hoil vehachometz eno rauy lishtiyya lebaddo belo taarobet, mikkol maqom, yesh lachosh lassebara harishona ulebarek al hachometz "shehakkol nihya bidbaro" veliptor hamme shelaqot, sheal kullam im amar "shehakkol nihya bidbaro" — yatza. Vaapillu im okel shemen im pat — en tzarik littol yadayv ulebarek "hammotzi" im eno mitkavven ella lirpua, sheap happat naasa tepela im eno mitkavven baakilatah ella bishbil hashshemen sheyyukal leoklah immo velo yazziq lo. Abal im hu raeb vetaeb leekol pat, ap al pi sheokel immah hashshemen lirpua — happat iqqar, umebarek aleha birkat "hammotzi" upoteret et hashshemen, kemo kol haddebarim habbaim mechamat hasseuda, kemo shennitbaer besiman qa"z. Veken hamareb shemen bishar mashqin lirpua vehu tzame vetaeb lishtot — hammashqin iqqar ledibre hakkol, im hem harob. Vekol zeh beshemen, shehu mazziq veen hanaa kelal bishtiyyato kemot shehu, abal okalim umashqim shehachek nehena mehem, ap al pi shehem mazziqim veqashim laggup — tzarik lebarek alehem beraka hamyuchedet lahem. Veim en hachek nehena mehem, ap al pi shehem yapim umoilim laggup — en mebarekin alehem, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman r"d:

Kol happerot, apillu zetim vaanabim, sheshsheraan o bishshelan bemayim, ap al pi shenniknas taam happeri bammayim — eno mebarek al otam hammayim ella "shehakkol", shehammayim hem iqqar. Bammeh debarim amurim? Beperot sheddarkan leoklan chayyin, abal mine yeraqot shedderek akilatam al yede bishshul — me bishshulam kemotam, sheal daat ken noteim otam, leekol gam memehem immahem o im pat, velo yatzeu mittorat okel legamre, ulepikak mebarekin alehem birkat hayraqot, ap im ba lishtotan bipne atzman. Abal perot shedderek akilatam chayyim ap im nityabbeshu, veaz en darkam leheakel chayyim ella al yede bishshul, mikkol maqom, en iqqar netiatam al daat ken, umebarek al memehem "shehakkol" im ba lishtotam bipne atzman, vekol shekken al me sheriyyatam. Veyesh omerim shekkol happerot me bishshulam o sheriyyatam kemotam, umebarek alehem "bore peri haetz" im ba lishtotam bipne atzman, shekkevan sheiqqar bishshul hammayim bishbil happerot, lepikak, kevan shennatenu happerot taam bahem — holekim achar hattaam, veenan domim lemashqin hayyotzeim mehapperot meatzmam, o al yede ketisha usechita, shezzea beolma hi, lepi shehammashqeh en lo taam happeri kemo sheyyesh lammaraq taam happeri. Usepeq berakot lehaqel, veim berak "bore peri haetz" — yatza, veen tzarik lachazor ulebarek. Abal lekattechilla yebarek "shehakkol" veyotze ledibre hakkol. Veim akal techilla happeri uberak "bore peri haetz" veachar kak ba lishtot hammaraq — lo yebarek alayv "shehakkol nihya bidbaro", ki shemma niptar kebar bebirkat "bore peri haetz", laken tob sheyyishteh dabar acher techilla lebarek alayv "shehakkol":

Vekol zeh latzet yede sepeq beraka rishona, abal im yesh sapeq bibraka acharona, kegon me sheriyyat o bishshul teenim o shear perot shel shibat hamminim, shebberaka acharona shellahem hi beraka achat meen g', ukesheshshoteh hammaraq lebaddo — yesh lehistappeq im mebarek meen g' o "bore nepashot rabbot", laken kol yere shamayim lo yishteh kashshiur ella betok hasseuda, o yokal peri miz' minim, vegam yishteh mayim, kede sheyyitztarek lebarek beraka achat meen g' vegam "bore nepashot rabbot". Apillu beme sheriyyat tzimmuqim yaaseh ken, im sheraan al daat leoklan im memehem, sheaz torat maraq al memehem velo torat yayin. Abal im sheraan shello al daat leoklan kelal, ella lishtot memehem lebad — torat yayin alehem, ap al pi shello mashak oto adayin min hatztzimmuqim, umebarek alayv "bore peri haggapen", al derek sheyyitbaer besiman ar"b. Veken bishar perot, im sheraam o bishshelam lishtot memehem lebad — en shem maraq alehem ella shem mashqeh, uledibre hakkol mebarek alehem "shehakkol nihya bidbaro" u"bore nepashot rabbot". Velaken mebarekin al shekar temarim "shehakkol nihya bidbaro" velo "bore peri haetz". Veken al mayim mebushshalim im alim sheqqorin (tyy"a) — en mebarekin alehem "bore peri haadama" mittaam zeh, ella "shehakkol nihya bidbaro". Veken maraq shel kol maaseh qedera mechameshet hamminin (ben shehaggarinim shelemim, raq sheenam omedim beenam, shennitbashshelu kol kak ad shennitmaaku ubirkatam "bore mine mezonot", ben shennechlequ bemakteshet lishnayim o lishlosha veyoter, ben tabshil miqqemach shel chameshet hamminim) — en hammaraq nechshab ketabshil lebarek alayv "bore mine mezonot", im ba lishtoto bipne atzmo, ella im ken bishshelo bishbil leekol hattabshil, sheaz hu batel legabbe hattabshil. Abal im iqqar habbishshul bishbil hammaraq lebaddo, kemo shemmebashshelim seorim lecholeh lishtot hammaraq lirpua, veken miqqemach osim lipamim meat lebibot umesimim gam ken meat qemach letok hammaraq, veiqqar hakkavvana al shetiyyat hammaraq velo al akilat hallebibot — mebarekin alayv "shehakkol nihya bidbaro", sheeno batel legabbe hattabshil veshem mashqeh alayv. Umittaam zeh mebarekin al shekar seorim "shehakkol nihya bidbaro" velo "bore mine mezonot", kemo sheyyitbaer besiman r"d. Vaapillu im okel gam ken hattabshil im hammaraq — en hammaraq niptar bebirkat hattabshil, sheenennu tapel elayv kelal, kevan sheiqqar habbishshul bishbil hammaraq. Umikkol maqom, kede laasot al tzad hayyoter tob — rauy lebarek "shehakkol nihya bidbaro" techilla al hammaraq velishtot mimmennu bipne atzmo meat, veachar kak mebarek al hattabshil "bore mine mezonot", sheggam hattabshil eno naasa tapel el hammaraq ap al pi sheiqqar habbishshul bishbilo, lepi shemmin dagan hu chashub veeno naasa tapel lehapsid birkato kol shebba litten taam baqqedera, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman r"ch. (Abal tabshil mimmin dagan shehaggarinim omedim beenam shebbirkato "bore peri haadama", hare hammaraq kemaraq shel shear perot, sheapillu iqqar habbishshul bishbil akilat happerot — en mebarekin al hammaraq ella "shehakkol nihya bidbaro" lassebara harishona, hoil veen derek akilatam al yede bishshul, veap chameshet mine dagan en derek akilatam al yede bishshul keshehem shelemim veomedim beenam, ella laasot mehem pat o tabshil leachar shennikteshu o nitchanu, shemmippene zeh en mebarekin alehem "bore mine mezonot" ella leachar shennikteshu o nitchanu, shehu derek akilatam, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman r"ch, mippene chashibutam. Abal mine qitniyyot shedderek akilatam al yede bishshul gam beodam shelemim veomedim beenam — mebarekim al hammaraq "bore peri haadama" ledibre hakkol, ap al pi shedderek leoklam gam ken chayyim. Vehu sheen iqqar habbishshul bishbil hammaraq lebaddo, abal im iqqar habbishshul bishbil hammaraq, ben bemine qitniyyot ben bemine dagan — mebarekin alayv "shehakkol" ap im okel gam ken hattabshil immo, veen hammaraq tapel elayv kelal veeno niptar bebirkato. Ella laasot al tzad hayyoter tob rauy lebarek techilla al hammaraq velishtot mimmennu meat bipne atzmo, veachar kak yebarek al hattabshil im hu min dagan. Abal im hu mimmine qitniyyot lo yebarek alayv kelal, mippene shehu tapel el hammaraq veniptar bebirkato, kevan sheiqqar habbishshul bishbilo, veken beperot sheiqqar bishshulam letzorek hammaraq. Abal mine yeraqot ap im nitbashshelu letzorek hammaraq, kegon lishtotam lirpua — mebarek alehem birkat hayraqot, kevan shekkol haolam mebashshelim otam laakila, veaz hammaraq batel legabbe tabshil — lo nishtannet birkat hammaraq bishbil zeh shebbishshelam letzorek memehem (ki betela dato etzel kol adam. Veeno domeh lemaraq shel seorim shemmebashshelim lecholeh, sheen lomar bahem kol kak betela dato etzel kol adam shemmebashshelim laakila vehammaraq batel legabbe hattabshil, shehare harbeh bene adam osim daysa misseorim shehi belo maraq kelal, veharbeh en mebashshelim oto kelal ella osim mimmennu pat. Veken mine qitniyyot, harbeh osim mehem keen daysa belo roteb kelal, veharbeh osim mehem pat, veharbeh okelim chayyim. Veken perot sheddarkam leheakel chayyim, vegam haybeshim sheen darkan leheakel chayyim — harbeh shorin otam letzorek memehem, kemo shergilim beaggasim yebeshim ubetzimmuqe anabim. Lepikak mebarekin alehem "shehakkol" ledibre hakkol). Umine zeraim sheenam neekalim leachar bishshulam ella sholeqin otam letzorek memehem, kegon hashshebet (sheqqorin any"sh) vekayyotze bo — zehu piryam, shello yatzeu mittorat okel legamre, kemo shennitbaer lemala. Vaapillu im natan letokan shemen lehakshiram velitten bahem taam — batel barob. Veim iqqar habbishshul hu raq bishbil hattabshil velo kede lishtot o leekol hammaraq im hattabshil kelal, kemo shergilim laasot bemine issa shemmebashshelim otam qodem hattiggun shello leekol hammaraq kelal — en mebarekin alayv ella "shehakkol nihya bidbaro" im ba lishtoto bipne atzmo, lepi sebara harishona, sheen mebarekin al maraq shel yeraqot kebirkat hayraqot atzman ella mishum shedderek akilatam hu im hayyaraq, lepikak nechshab peri kemotam, vehu haddin kan, en hammaraq nechshab mazon kehattabshil ella im ken darko leheakel immo ulekak nitbashshel. Abal lisbara acharona nahapok hu, kevan sheiqqar bishshul hammaraq bishbil hattabshil vehattabshil natan bo taam — nechshab kemoto, shennaasa tapel elayv. Veken me sheriyyat perot shennikbeshu bahem lehitqayyem — en mebarekin alehem ella "shehakkol nihya bidbaro" lepi sebara harishona, ap al pi shenniknas taam happeri bammayim, hoil velo nikbeshu bahem kede sheyyittenu bahem taam, velo hayeta hakkavvana kelal al hammayim sheyyihyu muksharim umutamim beyoter betaam happeri sheyyikkanes bahem, kemo shehakkavvana hi bebishshul yeraqot gam al hammayim sheyyihyu mutamim betaam hayyaraq, shellekak nechshabim kemotam, hoil venitbashshelu gam letzorek atzman velo letzorek hayraqot lebad. Abal lassebara haacharona nahapok hu:

Vekol zeh bemaraq shennitbashshel bo hammaakal o shennishra bo ad shennatan bo taam, abal im lo nitbashshel velo nishra bo ella sheereban leekol yachad uba lishtoto bipne atzmo — tzarik lebarek alayv beraka hamyuchedet lo ledibre hakkol. Ukesheakalan beyachad — en tzarik lebarek alayv kelum apillu hu [yayin], mippene shehu tapel lammaakal veniptar bebirkato. Veim iqqar kavvanato hu al hammaraq vehammaakal hu letzorek shetiyyat hammaraq — mebarek al hammaraq. Veim kavvanato al shenehem — en holekin bo achar harob, ella mebarek al shenehem, techilla al hammaakal veokel mimmennu meat, veachar kak "shehakkol nihya bidbaro" al hammaraq. Abal lo yebarek al shenehem yachad, ki beraka hashsheniyya tihyeh mapseqet ben beraka rishona latteima. Vaapillu im hammaakal hu min dagan — eno nechshab iqqar liptor hammaraq bebirkato, lepi sheap min dagan shennaasa rak verauy lishtiyya kemaraq en mebarekin alayv "bore mine mezonot", kemo sheyyitbaer besiman r"ch. Abal maraq shennitbashshel bo hammaakal o nishra bo venatan bo taam — hare hu batel legabbe hammaakal ukeokel hu chashub, hoil veiqqaro bishbil hammaakal, kemo shennitbaer lassebara haacharona, o mippene shedderek hammaakal leekol immo maraq o im pat velo yatza mittorat okel legamre, kemo shennitbaer lassebara harishona:

Vaapillu bemaraq shennitbashshel bo lo nechlequ ella keshennitbashshel bo happeri lebad belo basar, abal im nitbashshel bo basar — ledibre hakkol mebarek alayv "shehakkol" im ba lishtoto bipne atzmo, apillu bemaraq shel yeraqot, ki taam habbasar shebbammaraq chashub iqqar yoter mittaam hayraqot o happeri. (Abal maraq shel tabshil mimmin dagan shemmebarekin alayv "bore mine mezonot", hare taam haddagan shebbammaraq chashub iqqar yoter mittaam habbasar, shemmin dagan chashub mikkol hamminim, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman r"ch):

Viraqot shennitbashshelu bechometz o bemashqeh sheqqorin barsh"t, o bemashqeh acher chutz mimmayim — en mebarekin al hammaraq birkat hayraqot lepi sebara harishona, sheen me yeraqot chashubim kemotam ella mippene shemmebashshelim bahem ad sheyyittenu taam bahem veyoklum gam ken, vahare ap im lo haya habbishshul ella bishbil hammaraq lebaddo leoklo betaam hayraqot shenniknas bo al yede habbishshul lo hayu mebarekin alayv birkat hayraqot, kevan sheyyesh lehachometz o shear mashqeh od taam shel atzmo — hare taam zeh iqqar, kemo beperot hamruqqachim bidbash shettaam shellahem chashub iqqar umebarekim alehem birkatam velo birkat haddebash, ap al pi shennitbashshelu kede sheyyitten taam bahem. Velo ameru shemmeraq hayraqot kemotam, ella bemayim sheen lahem taam hanaa shel atzmam ella lemi shehu tzame, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman r"d. Abal lassebara haacharona, im iqqar habbishshul bishbil hayraqot — hare hammaraq batel etzlam venechshab kemotam mishshennatenu bo taam, ap al pi sheyyesh lahem od taam shellahem:

Kol happerot, ben perot haetz ben perot haadama, en mebarekim alehem birkatam ella bederek akilatam, sheal daat ken noteim otam, veim darkam leoklam mebushshalim mippene shehem tobim yoter mebushshalim mechayyim, ap al pi shehem tobim ureuyim laakila gam keshehem chayyim — en mebarekim alehem birkatam ella leachar habbishshul, abal keshehem chayyim mebarekim alehem "shehakkol nihya bidbaro". Abal perot shedderek akilatam hu gam ken leoklam chayyim, apillu hem tobim mebushshalim yoter mechayyim — mebarekin alehem birkatam, ben chayyim ben mebushshalim. Vaapillu perot shedderek akilatam hu keshehem chayyim velo mebushshalim, sheen derek rob haolam lebashshelam — lo nishtannet birkatam bishbil shebbishshelam, shekkevan shehiggiu liklal peri keshehem chayyim — en habbishshul mebattel torat peri mehem. Vehu shello nishtanna taamam ligriuta, shehem tobim mebushshalim kemo chayyim, abal im hem tobim yoter chayyim mimmebushshalim, kevan shennishtannu midderek akilatam ligriuta betaamam — yaredu mimmaalatam, umebarekim alehem "shehakkol nihya bidbaro" keshehem mebushshalim:

Veken im nishtanna tooram legamre al yede habbishshul mikkemot shehaya beodam bederek akilatam, kegon shennitbashshelu kol kak ad shennimmochu legamre, sheen alehem toar happeri kemot shehaya beodennu chay shehu derek akilato — nishtannet birkatam, umebarekim alehem "shehakkol nihya bidbaro". Abal perot shedderek akilatam hu keshehem mebushshalim, ap al pi shennimmochu — derek akilatam hu bekak, velo nishtannet birkatam, ap al pi shennishtanna tooram legamre. Veim lo nimmochu legamre vaadayin toar happeri alehem — lo nishtannet birkatam ap al pi sheen derek akilatam bekak, kegon temarim shemmiakan bayyad veasa mehem issa leachar shehotzi mehem garinam, veken kol kayyotze bahem mishshear perot, ap al pi sheen darkam bekak — ap al pi ken lo nishtannet birkatam, umebarek alehem "bore peri haetz", hoil velo nishtanna tooram legamre. (Veenan domot leqemach shel chittim, sheapillu lo nitchan daq daq ella adayin yesh bo taam shel chittim ureuyim laakila qetzat chayyin, veap al pi ken eno mebarek alayv birkat hachittin shehi "bore peri haadama" ella "shehakkol nihya bidbaro", lepi shennishtanna toar hachittim legamre bitchinatam, ap al pi shello nitchanu daq daq keqemach gamur, mah sheen ken bitmarim vekayyotze bahem shennitmaaku adayin toar peri alehem[)]. Abal shumshemin shettechanan, veken egoz shekketasho beyoter ad sheeno nikkar bemahuto vetooro — mebarek alehem "shehakkol nihya bidbaro", hoil veen darkam bekak. Veken qitniyyot mebushshalim shennitmaaku derek keli menuqqab shehen daqqim meod. [Abal] im miek otam bekap — mebarek alehem "bore peri haadama", kevan shemmammashan qayyam, venikkar mahutan vetooran, veod, shedderek akilatam bekak. Veken perot shennikteshu beyoter ad sheen tooram alehem, im hu derek akilatam — lo nishtannet birkatam, kegon (zngby"l) o besamim shechuqim umeorabim im (tzvq"r), o meruqqachim bidbash — lo nishtannet birkatam, mippene shedderek akilat habbesamim hi al yede shechiqa. Veken veradim vekayyotze bahem mipperot shedderek akilatam hu lechotkam uleraqqecham — mebarekim alehem birkatam apillu hem ketushim beyoter sheen tooram nikkar alehem kelal, ki gam zeh derek akilatam, meachar sheen darkam leheakel keshehem shelemim belo riqquach. Abal egoz hamruqqach bidbash ad sheeno nikkar bemahuto vetooro — mebarekim alayv "shehakkol nihya bidbaro", hoil vederek akilato hu beodo chay veshalem. Veken kol kayyotze bo mipperot hanneekalim chayyim. (Ubirkat havveradim hi "bore peri haadama", lepi sheenan iqqar happeri, ki perachim hemma. Veken halloneddris eno iqqar happeri). Veyesh omerim, sheapillu perot shennimmochu legamre bebishshul veen alehem toar happeri kelal, o shennikteshu beyoter ad sheen mahutan vetooran nikkar kelal — lo nishtannet birkatam ap al pi sheen derek akilatam bekak. Veenan domim leqemach chittim shello nitchan daq daq, lepi shehaqqemach yesh lo illuy achar sheosin mimmennu pat, vezeh iqqar piryo, sheal daat ken zoreim otam, lepikak kevan shennishtanna veyatza mikkelal peri velo ba leiqqar piryo — nigra veyarad mimmaalat peri haadama lebarek alayv "shehakkol nihya bidbaro", mah sheen ken beperot sheen osin mehem pat — en shinnuyam motziam mittorat peri legamre leshannot birkatam. Abal mine qitniyyot shedderek bene adam laasot mehem pat, hare shinnuyam motziam mittorat piryam ledibre hakkol, apillu nishtannu achar bishshulam, sheaz en derek laasot mehem pat. Veen tzarik lomar sheim nishtannu beodan chayyim, kegon mine qitniyyot tytarq"y shettochanin otam qetzat, sheqqorin grvpy"n, veosin tabshil miqqimchan keen daysa — mebarekin alayv "shehakkol". (Abal lassebara harishona mebarekin alayv "bore peri haadama", shehare zehu derek akilato, veadderabba asiyyat pat miqqitniyyot eno derek akilato, shehare mebarekin alayv "shehakkol nihya bidbaro", kemo sheyyitbaer besiman r"ch. Velassebara haacharona, mah shemmebarekim al pat qitniyyot "shehakkol nihya bidbaro", ap al pi sheen lah illuy acher — zehu mippene shehappat nishtanna veyatza mittorat peri legamre, yoter mishshinnuy qemach o perot hannimmochim o hannitchanim vehanniktashim beyoter). Uleinyan halaka bekol zeh, sepeq beraka lehaqel bediabad, abal lekattechilla yebarek "shehakkol nihya bidbaro", latzet ledibre hakkol:

Egoz hamtuggan bidbash, apillu bishshelo bemayim qodem hattiggun venishtanna taamo ligriuta, ubirkato az "shehakkol nihya bidbaro", ap al pi ken keshechozer venitqan al yede hattiggun — chozer lebirkato shehi "bore peri haetz". Veap shettiqqun zeh hu al yede haddebash ubirkat haddebash hi "shehakkol", mikkol maqom haegoz hu chashub iqqar vehaddebash tapel elayv letaqqeno ulehakshiro. Veken bekol mine perot meruqqachim, ben perot hailan ben perot haaretz. Vaapillu perot sheenan reuyim laakila kelal belo tiggun bidbash, kegon veradim vekayyotze bahem — en haddebash chashub iqqar ella tapel, shehare eno ba ella lehakshir happeri laakila, vahare zeh kipri sheen darko leoklo chay ella mebushshal, shemmebarekin alayv birkato velo birkat hammayim shennitbashshel bahem vehikshiruhu laakila:

Bammeh debarim amurim? Beperot shennigmar bishshulam, abal perot sheenam reuyim laakila apillu al yede haddechaq keshehem chayyim mippene shello nigmar bishshulam vehikshiram al yede debash — haddebash hu iqqar. Vaapillu im metaggenan belo debash — mebarek alehem "shehakkol nihya bidbaro", mittaam shennitbaer lemala. Lepikak, egozim shemmebashshelim bidbash beodam yeruqqim verakkim — mebarekim alehem "shehakkol nihya bidbaro", shehare hem marim veenam reuyim laakila kelal belo debash:

Qanim hammetuqim shessochatin otan umebashshelim memehem ad shenniqpaot veyidmu lemelach (sheqqorin tzvq"r), veken hammotzetz otan - yesh omerim shemmebarek "shehakkol nihya bidbaro" keal shear me perot. Veyesh omerim sheenan domin lishar me perot, hoil veen haqqanim reuyim laakila, veen notein otam ella bishbil memehem — zehu piryam, umebarekim alehem "bore peri haetz". Usepeq berakot lehaqel bediabad, abal lekattechilla yebarek "shehakkol" latzet ledibre hakkol:

Pilpelin beodan retubbim shehem reuyim laakila — yesh omerim shemmebarek alehem "bore peri haetz", kevan shehem gedelim bailan. Veyesh omerim shemmebarekim alehem "bore peri haadama", hoil veiqqar netiatam hu al daat sheyyityabbeshu veyeakelu rubbam shechuqim [ke]tablin, veenan neekalin bipne atzmam ella miutam lipamim. Usepeq berakot lehaqel bediabad, abal lekattechilla yebarek "bore peri haadama" latzet ledibre hakkol:

Abal pilpelin yebeshim vezangebil yabesh veken hatztzipporen (sheqqorin nagly"k) , vekol kayyotze beellu sheen neekalim beyobesh ella al yede taarobet — en mebarekin alehem kelum kesheokelam bipne atzmam, sheen zo akila shel hanaa lebarek aleha birkat hannehenin. Abal etz shel qinnamon (sheqqorin tzmryn"d) regilin leoklo beyobesh, umebarekin alayv "bore peri haadama", ki hu gadel al haaretz kemo qanim:

Veken egoz sheqqorin museqa"t nv"s regilin gam ken leoklo beyobesh, umebarekin alayv "bore peri haetz". Umi sheyyesh lo shilshul venoten hammuseqa"t letok hashshekar kede sheyyaatzor, im eno tzame veeno shoteh ella lirpua — hammuseqa"t iqqar vehashshekar tapel, umebarek "bore peri haetz". Veim hu tzame o taeb lishtot hashshekar gam belo repua, ap al pi shennoten letoko hammuseqa"t lirpua — hashshekar iqqar, umebarek "shehakkol" upoter et hammuseqa"t (hoil ubeliat hammuseqa"t hu al yede shekar, ubiladayv lo haya boleo). Veap sheyyesh omerim sheapillu shemen sheeno rauy laakila kelal belo taarobet, veap al pi ken im erebo beezeh mashqeh — en hammashqeh nechshab iqqar ella im ken hashshemen muat shehu batel betoko berob, kemo shennitbaer lemala, vekan shehammuseqa"t vehashshekar enan niblalim zeh bazeh, ella hammuseqa"t omed beeno betok hashshekar, en lelek achar rob shekar, ella im ken haya mitbashshel bo, kemo shennitbaer lemala, veim ken haya tzarik lebarek al hammuseqa"t bipne atzmo veal hashshekar bipne atzmo — mikkol maqom sepeq berakot lehaqel:

Kol peri shehu mesuppaq bo im hu peri haetz o peri haadama, sheeno yodea leborero al pi hassiman sheyyitbaer besiman r"g, o peri haetz shemmistappeq bo im hu iqqar happeri im lav — yebarek "bore peri haadama". Veim eno yodea mah hu — mebarek "shehakkol nihya bidbaro". Umikkol maqom, im hu dabar sheyyakol lepotro betok hasseuda — hu tob yoter, sheaz en sapeq kelal. Vekol zeh besapeq shennistappeq lo achar shellamad, abal mi shello lamad — lo yokal bebirkat "shehakkol", ki enah poteret hakkol ella bediabad velo lekattechilla kesheepshar, vezeh epshar lo lelek etzel chakam sheyyelammedennu hilkot berakot:
